notes: Pose endpoints are explicitly authored from the reference, with staged rendered comparison of silhouette, eyes/mouth, ears, scalp, bun and rear hair.
The face cage preserves landmark order and shared skin/feature mapping. Scalp and bun have separate authored endpoint contours; hanging roots share the scalp.
Neutral SVG and all 12 expression controls remain unchanged. Head poses are local preview state, never exported or synchronized.
Reference registration uses a uniform .58 scale and torso translation; no pose-specific image stretching.
Hair strand artwork, profile nose marks and ornaments retain the source drawing; reference likeness does not mean pixel identity.

keyformProvenance.method: Artist-authored source/target landmarks, inspected in face → features → ears → hair stages; TPS only interpolates landmark interiors.
keyformProvenance.normalization: Reference grid 2048/3, scale .58, neutral eye row 323→198.5, centre 341→444; pose torso registration recorded in author review.
